epics.title: Let each app choose its fonts

features.title: Load fonts from Google Fonts and let each app choose its own
features.description: Load them from Google Fonts instead of the `@fontsource/ibm-plex-*` imports, and let each app choose its fonts.
features.statusNote: Mostly on bh's main already: 195df76 loads the fonts from Google Fonts in the docs, with no `@fontsource`; the tokens name IBM Plex as the default, and an app picks its own by setting `--font-sans` and `--font-mono` in an `@theme` after the imports (the docs' Styles and fonts page, "Fonts of your own"); the lifecycle block measures the app's mono font. Left, as the plan below: `@bh/erd` still measures its cards in IBM Plex Mono, and nothing tests that an app's fonts replace Plex. tickets and gateway keep their `@fontsource` imports, which works, since the tokens still name Plex. BH-14.1 (953fa09) and BH-14.2 (a410f1b) on bh branch `bh-14`, in `../bh-wt-bh-14`, cut from bh's main (b909d45), not merged: `@bh/erd` measures its cards in the root's `--font-mono`, read at each measure, falling back to Tailwind's `--default-mono-font-family` and then a glyph's width; a test compiles `tokens.css` with an app's own `@theme` fonts and checks `font-sans`, `font-mono`, `html`, `body` and `code` take them. Found: `--font-mono` reaches the page's root only when a scanned source mentions it, so an app that doesn't scan `@bh/erd` may lack it (hence the fallback); always emitting it would be a token change in `@bh/ui`. Merged: `bh-14` into bh's main (dd47451), released in bh 0.4.0.
today: the docs app imported five `@fontsource` stylesheets in `apps/docs/src/main.tsx` and `apps/docs/src/iframe/main.tsx` (gone in 195df76);
the token font stacks name IBM Plex directly in `packages/web/ui/src/style/generated/typography.ts` (generated), so an app can't swap them;
`lifecycle/layout.ts:65` (a markdown block) assumes IBM Plex Mono's character width;
the setup page documented the `@fontsource` imports (`apps/docs/content/getting-started/styles-and-fonts.doc.yaml`; no longer).

plan.title: Measure `@bh/erd`'s cards in the app's mono font
plan.description: `packages/web/erd/src/engine/geometry/measure-entity.ts` sizes a card by measuring its names in IBM Plex Mono, named in the file, so an app with other fonts gets cards sized for Plex. It reads `--font-mono` from the page's root, as the lifecycle block does (`useMonoMeasure` in `packages/web/markdown/src/blocks/lifecycle/lifecycle.tsx`), and keeps a mono glyph's width when there's no document or canvas.

plan.title: Add a test that an app's own fonts replace IBM Plex
plan.description: Builds a stylesheet like the docs' "Fonts of your own" example (`@bh/ui/tokens.css`, then an `@theme` naming other fonts) and checks that `font-sans`, `font-mono` and the page's own text take the app's fonts, so the docs' promise holds when the tokens change.

features.title: Add `LogView`, a log viewer for any app's logs
features.description: A log viewer in `@bh/ui` for any app's logs. It knows nothing of the app: the app says which lines start a section, and at which level, and adds highlight rules of its own. Planned and built as the gateway's GW-13.

blockedBy.why: planned and built as GW-13's tickets

design.text: https://claude.ai/artifact/373FqCFMX7MWWu3U33K7Nf (done, running, failed, service logs, dark, anatomy).
items: Sections nested to any depth, each folding, with its time and duration; the last and any failed one open, the rest folded.

Highlights by default: timestamps dimmed; errors red, warnings orange (a wash on the line), successes green; ANSI colors drawn in bh's hues, never shown as codes; a Readable / Raw switch for JSON lines.
A multi-line entry (a stack trace) folds under its first line, for logs with no sections.
Follows the end while lines arrive, unless the reader scrolled up ("jump to the end"). No scroll box of its own: the toolbar and the section being read stick to the top of the page.
Find marks matches and opens the folds that hold them; keys ↑ ↓ → ← Enter.
Tests (sections, ANSI parsing, following, thousands of lines staying fast) and a docs page.

epics.title: Fix bh's safelist holding classes nothing draws

plan.title: Add a hue list to a `variants()` axis, and safelist only those
plan.description: An axis may name the hues it takes; the safelist extractor (`scripts/extract-safelist.mjs`) writes only those, and `LogView`'s unused `text-*-12` classes go. Without a list, an axis takes every hue, as today.

features.title: Let a `variants()` axis take only some hues
features.description: A component's tone and hue classes reach Tailwind through `variants()`, which lists every hue for an axis, so the safelist holds classes the component never draws. Found while building `LogView` (GW-13.2), which safelists 10 `text-*-12` classes it doesn't use.
